comments.author: @OuterAtlas96
comments.text: The fact that people used to simply walk or take skin boats across to visit their own family before the Cold War divided them is heartbreaking [11:54]. Seeing your relatives' island every day from your window and not being able to cross really puts 'The Ice Curtain' into perspective [13:25]. What an incredible, moving documentary!

comments.author: @Glyn-r
comments.text: Fantastic video. I'd love to live there as long as someone moved the date line and got rid of that snow.
